description: This file contains Lua functions for parsing Lua source code comments, extracting documentation, parameters, return values, examples, and method declarations, primarily for generating documentation or introspection purposes.

methods.name: parse_description
methods.description: Parses comment text to extract description, converting markdown-like syntax within comment lines.

methods.name: parse_param
methods.description: Parses a parameter tag string to extract parameter name and description.

methods.name: parse_description
methods.description: Extracts brief description from comments, ignoring tags and code blocks.

methods.name: parse_bottom_description
methods.description: Extracts bottom section description from comments after parameter tags.

methods.name: parse_return
methods.description: Parses return annotation in comments to identify return variable and description.

methods.name: parse_examples
methods.description: Extracts examples from comments, including source code and live indicators.

methods.name: parse_calls
methods.description: Extracts function calls and arguments from comments.

methods.name: parse_comment
methods.description: Consolidates parsing of a comment block into a structured documentation object.

methods.name: get_declaration
methods.description: Generates a function declaration string from method name and parameters.

methods.name: get_declarations
methods.description: Creates multiple declarations for each call within a method.

methods.name: parse_header
methods.description: Parses Lua source code to extract documented methods and callback functions.

methods.name: remove_html_tags
methods.description: Removes HTML tags from a string.

methods.name: all
methods.description: Scans a directory for header files, parses them, and returns documented modules and methods.
